name: Cave bugs

variantInfo.name: Cave bug
notes: Standard level 6 cave bug (npc 481), the Slayer-task target in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
A larger level 96 cave bug (npc 483, 93 Slayer XP) lives in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon and also counts.
Weak, low-HP monster; killed almost incidentally once a light source is carried.

locationComparison.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
notes: Primary cave bug location; requires a rope to enter and a light source inside.
A Dwarf multicannon can be used here.
Spawn count not stated on the wiki (honest UNKNOWN).

taskNotes: Cave bugs are assigned by Turael, Spria, and Mazchna and require 7 Slayer.
A light source is required to enter and fight in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves; open flames are extinguished by the swamp gas, so an oil/bullseye lantern or a light-emitting alternative is needed.
Cave bugs have only 5 hitpoints and a max hit of 1; they are trivial once you are in the caves.
The standard cave bug (npc 481) is level 6; a level 96 variant (npc 483) in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon also counts for the task.
Cave bugs have a 50% weakness to fire spells; melee is the simplest option for such a low-HP monster.
The slayerTargetId 279 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist section 1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The wikiPageId was not captured at authoring time (honest UNKNOWN); sourceUrl is https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Cave_bug.
recommendedMethod: Bring a light source (oil or bullseye lantern) and any melee weapon; cave bugs have 5 HP and a max hit of 1, so kill them with whatever you are carrying. Fire spells hit them for 50% extra if training Magic in the caves.
